newsitem.title: UK: PWS says profits flat in first six months.
newsitem.headline: PWS says profits flat in first six months.

text.p: Specialist international reinsurance broker PWS Holdings Plc on Wednesday reported flat operating profits for the six months ending March 31.
It also warned that with little improvement in market conditions anticipated and the impact of the strong pound, margins would remain under pressure during the second half.
But the company said that it had made progress in its aim to increase brokerage revenue, while keeping downward pressure on its cost base.
Despite the difficult conditions brokerage revenues edged up three percent to 5.71 million pounds.
However, PWS said that continuing pressure on premiums and currency strength mitigated the impact of top-line growth.
By mid-morning PWS shares were trading unchanged at 18 pence.

Operating profits for the year were just two percent higher at 0.772 million pounds. After exceptionals including a small loss on the sale of its 51 percent stake in PWS Asia Pacific, pre-tax profits slipped to 0.53 million pounds.
The company said it remains committed to operating in the region and intends to set up a new, wholly owned subsidiary in Singapore in the near future.
